Prestige Properties

The original prompt, shown in full as plain text.

Prompt

Create a homepage for a luxury real estate agency called "Prestige Properties". Include these sections:

1. HERO SECTION
- Full-width image of stunning property exterior
- Headline: "Find Your Dream Home"
- Subheadline: "Luxury properties in [City Name] and surrounding areas"
- Prominent search bar with:
  - Buy/Rent toggle
  - Location autocomplete
  - Property type dropdown (House, Condo, Townhouse, Land)
  - Price range sliders
  - "Search Properties" button

2. QUICK FILTERS
- Horizontal pill buttons for popular searches:
  - Waterfront, New Construction, Open House This Weekend, Price Reduced, Luxury ($1M+)

3. FEATURED LISTINGS (Grid of 6)
- Property image (with carousel dots)
- Price prominently displayed
- Address
- Beds, Baths, Sq Ft
- "New" or "Open House" badges
- Heart icon to save
- Listing agent thumbnail

4. WHY CHOOSE US
- 25+ Years of Experience
- $2B+ in Sales Volume
- 500+ Happy Families
- #1 Agency in [Area]
- Brief paragraphs for each with icons

5. NEIGHBORHOODS SECTION
- Visual cards for popular neighborhoods
- Aerial or landmark photo
- Neighborhood name
- Average price range
- Number of listings
- "Explore" button

6. MEET OUR AGENTS
- Top 4 agents with photos
- Name, title, specialization
- Contact info
- Number of transactions
- "View Profile" link
- "View All Agents" button

7. CLIENT TESTIMONIALS
- 3 testimonials with client photos
- Star ratings
- Specific results mentioned
- Property type they purchased

8. MARKET INSIGHTS
- Current market statistics
- Average home price
- Days on market
- Month-over-month trends
- Link to full market report

9. SELLING YOUR HOME?
- CTA section for sellers
- "Get a Free Home Valuation"
- Address input
- Brief value propositions

10. FOOTER
- Office locations with maps
- Contact numbers
- MLS disclaimer
- Fair housing logo
- Social media links

Design: Elegant, trustworthy with navy blue (#1E3A5F) and gold (#C9A962) accents. High-quality property photography. Clean typography. Professional and sophisticated feel.
